rationale: B is comparatively stronger because it improves timeout metadata formatting and adds subprocess-cancellation coverage, but both patches fail mandatory requirements: neither propagates an actual scout deadline through the engine, both replace independent per-tool timeouts with a shared duration, and both report fixed timeout durations rather than accurate elapsed metadata for active or unstarted work. Their tests do not exercise the real scout deadline boundary or engine propagation.

requirement_results.requirement: Propagate the actual scout deadline into repository batches
requirement_results.A: Not met: no engine/API propagation is shown; the batch derives a new deadline from tool_timeout.
requirement_results.B: Not met: no engine/API propagation is shown; the batch derives a new deadline from tool_timeout.

requirement_results.A: Substantively met: completed results are stored and ready futures are drained at timeout.
requirement_results.B: Substantively met: completed results are stored and ready futures are drained at timeout.

requirement_results.requirement: Cancel outstanding work and slow subprocesses
requirement_results.A: Partially met: outstanding futures and ripgrep children are cancellable via drop and kill_on_drop, but coverage is incomplete.
requirement_results.B: Mostly met: outstanding futures and ripgrep children are cancellable, with focused subprocess coverage.

requirement_results.requirement: Preserve accurate failure and duration metadata
requirement_results.A: Not met: timeout metadata always uses the full configured duration, including for never-started calls, and subsecond messages can say 0s.
requirement_results.B: Not met: timeout metadata still always uses the full configured duration, including for never-started calls, despite better message formatting.

requirement_results.requirement: Avoid changing independent per-tool timeout semantics
requirement_results.A: Not met: the per-tool timeout wrapper is removed and replaced by a shared batch deadline.
requirement_results.B: Not met: the per-tool timeout wrapper is removed and replaced by a shared batch deadline.

requirement_results.requirement: Include focused regression coverage at the real deadline boundary
requirement_results.A: Not met: the test uses a relative duration budget and does not cover actual scout-deadline propagation or the precise boundary.
requirement_results.B: Not met: tests cover relative batch cancellation and subprocess dropping, but not the real scout deadline boundary or propagation.
